category_2_reader_warning: Category 2 covers BOTH Hanson pre-onset windows and comparison screen spans. Category alone cannot distinguish them: inspect attrs.evidence_tier (onset_window_uncertain versus unlabelled_screen). Neither tier is a verified negative; do not pool them by category.
coverage: Hanson category 0 is assumed absence before the first precursor; Hanson category 2 is the uncertain 20 ms pre-onset convention. Hanson category 1 is one minimal 10 ms post-onset slice, not a measured duration. Comparison category 2 is the rwm_candidates screen, unlabelled and not negative. Reviewed negative coverage is unknown.

rules.present: Hanson: [ONSET_TIME, ONSET_TIME + 10 ms) for either mode number, one minimal present slice; evidence tier onset_point_minimal. Mode duration is unmeasured. Present evidence takes precedence over overlapping uncertain windows.
rules.absent: high-current time only before the first listed onset minus 100 ms, assuming complete onset listing. No post-onset physical absence is inferred without mode termination evidence. A span whose attrs carry unexplained_beta_collapse holds a sharp beta_N fall of unestablished cause.
rules.uncertain: Hanson: [20 ms before ONSET_TIME, ONSET_TIME), of either mode number, as a convention with unverified pre-onset presence and extent; overlapping present time takes precedence. Comparison: rwm_candidates screen spans.
rules.unassessed: explicit precursor gaps and time beyond minimal present slices, apart from later uncertain onset windows; comparison time outside screen spans

onset_time_provenance.finding: Hanson source CSVs and category README name onset times but do not define growth-start versus detection/threshold timing. Piccione digests describe NSTX threshold t_RWM and cannot establish the meaning of Hanson's DIII-D ONSET_TIME.
onset_time_provenance.forecast_target: separate 100 ms point-time forecast target; unchanged

evidence_tiers.onset_point_minimal: category 1 on Hanson shots: [o, o+10 ms), one minimal present slice from the listed onset; not a measured duration
evidence_tiers.onset_window_uncertain: category 2 on Hanson shots: [o-20 ms, o) by convention; ONSET_TIME meaning, pre-onset presence and extent unverified
evidence_tiers.assumed_absent: Hanson time before first precursor; completeness assumption. A span whose attrs carry unexplained_beta_collapse holds a sharp beta_N fall of unestablished cause and is not clean assumed absence
evidence_tiers.unlabelled_screen: category 2 on comparison shots: rwm_candidates screen spans, not onset windows or verified negatives
evidence_tiers.unassessed: no assessed physical state or termination evidence

reader_contract: review reader preserves all explicit rows and attrs; tier-less saves of tiered sources are rejected
onset_interval_attributes: attrs.source_onsets preserves every contributing original NTOR, MODE_TYPE, ONSET_TIME (ms) and source, including merged duplicates
